stable.score_definition: log((1-max_softmax)/max_softmax), computed by logsumexp over nonmax logits minus the maximum, in float64. Exact-real strictly monotone MSP transform.
stable.status: Post-review numerical sensitivity; legacy raw observations preserved. All temperature/source choices recomputed using validation only, never target-selected.

pacs.interval_scope: 400 shared-content-image Poisson draws; fits and validation choices frozen, test ROC thresholds recomputed under the same 95-percent-recall rule. Conditional sensitivity only, not population or retraining uncertainty.
